source_status: Static source paths; no new runtime validation.

signals.availability: verified source implementation; mod delivery not runtime-tested
signals.semantics: Persistent current area; initialization stops/starts regional music.
signals.integration: Public map query; native regional Play event already reaches Wwise.
signals.reliability_limits: Area is coarse, not biome or discovery; load/fast travel reseeds lifecycle.
signals.minimum_runtime_test: Log current area and initialization across ordinary reload, no travel manipulation.
signals.cadence_and_duplicate_semantics: Persistent query; initialization/world load edges, not per-frame arrival.

signals.availability: verified Wwise definitions/actions; game event producer coverage incomplete
signals.semantics: Regional location Switch, not a generic arrival notification.
signals.integration: Already Wwise; no script getter established. Native hook delivery requires separate proof.
signals.reliability_limits: Duplicates are normal; same event is not fresh arrival. Review selector consumers; world location can be thematic.
signals.minimum_runtime_test: Observe existing location events and actual effective selector, never force location.
signals.cadence_and_duplicate_semantics: Event frequency unmeasured; identical events need not restart playback (report90).

signals.availability: verified source implementation; mod delivery not runtime-tested
signals.semantics: Native music-state getter; default classifier includes explicit-state priority.
signals.integration: Public GetCurrentGameState; Wwise game_state already native.
signals.reliability_limits: Exploration does not imply authored-free or outro-complete; script getter is not exact audio timing.
signals.minimum_runtime_test: Log getter alongside native state changes; preserve all setters.
signals.cadence_and_duplicate_semantics: State changes;0.15s source throttle is not proof of CollectSoundStates caller frequency.

signals.availability: verified source implementation; mod delivery not runtime-tested
signals.semantics: Game-time thresholds; day/night transition events/timer exist.
signals.integration: envMgr.IsNight query; native exploration State names already Wwise.
signals.reliability_limits: Game time skips/meditation differ from monotonic opportunity clock; day/night is context, not significance.
signals.minimum_runtime_test: Log stable day/night and game-time discontinuity without altering time.
signals.cadence_and_duplicate_semantics: Game-time boundary timer and pollable threshold; meditation/time skip can jump.

signals.availability: verified source implementation; mod delivery not runtime-tested
signals.semantics: Weather-name/rain/snow queries; World.OnWeatherChange forwards to player.
signals.integration: Script queries or localized world/player hook; direct regional music routing not established.
signals.reliability_limits: OnWeatherChanged suppresses voice commentary in scenes/interiors/first60s; do not reuse commentary eligibility as event availability.
signals.minimum_runtime_test: Log world change and current query through natural weather transition; debounce blends.
signals.cadence_and_duplicate_semantics: Native callback cadence unmeasured; blend/query values may evolve continuously.

signals.availability: verified source implementation; mod delivery not runtime-tested
signals.semantics: Fast-travel trigger checks player, disables FirstDiscoveryTrigger, invokes script map-pin discovery; wrapper tests previous saved discovery.
signals.integration: Localized wrapper/callback observation, not existing Wwise input.
signals.reliability_limits: Wrapper also called by quests/inventory/debug; discovery can occur remotely. Filter source, false→true and type; never guarantee music.
signals.minimum_runtime_test: Log existing natural first discovery: previous/new/tag/type/caller category; reload must not retrigger.
signals.cadence_and_duplicate_semantics: Player trigger and first-discovery flag; wrapper can also run from nonlocal sources.

signals.availability: verified source implementation; mod delivery not runtime-tested
signals.semantics: Broad map mutation signal emits scripted event with no tag/type payload.
signals.integration: Dispatcher AddListener exists, but map-change event alone is insufficient.
signals.reliability_limits: Not proof of discovery/proximity; do not start music on every UI/map change or diff all-world pins at high frequency.
signals.minimum_runtime_test: If used, log reasons/coverage first; no opportunity generation in pilot.
signals.cadence_and_duplicate_semantics: Any map-pin mutation; no unique discovery payload.

signals.availability: verified source implementation; mod delivery not runtime-tested
signals.semantics: W3LocationArea trigger displays area name; saved discovery reward conditional.
signals.integration: Entity-local event, no central arrival bus established.
signals.reliability_limits: Source has no player guard in this handler; repeat/name/reward conditions and placement coverage need validation.
signals.minimum_runtime_test: Observe player identity and repeat enter on an already naturally visited area.
signals.cadence_and_duplicate_semantics: Repeat trigger enters; saved reward/discovered conditions are entity-specific.

signals.availability: verified source implementation; mod delivery not runtime-tested
signals.semantics: Journal area derived from current area and player position.
signals.integration: Public script method; not a semantic biome.
signals.reliability_limits: Hardcoded regional partition; cannot infer woodland/mountain/vista from journal area label.
signals.minimum_runtime_test: Log query transitions and compare location selector without narrative content.

signals.availability: verified source implementation; mod delivery not runtime-tested
signals.semantics: Horse query distinguishes mount in progress; boat query tests used vehicle.
signals.integration: Public actor queries; vehicle callbacks available but mod hook uncompiled.
signals.reliability_limits: Mounting is not a dramatic opportunity by itself; use only mounted flag if needed.
signals.minimum_runtime_test: Log foot/mount/mounted/dismount during normal play, no forced action.
signals.cadence_and_duplicate_semantics: Persistent mount/vehicle state plus mount callbacks; mounting-in-progress must be excluded explicitly.

signals.availability: verified source implementation; mod delivery not runtime-tested
signals.semantics: MovingAgent speed/velocity and sprint state; locomotion consumes velocity.
signals.integration: Script property query; avoid animation-state-name classifier.
signals.reliability_limits: Movement speed != meaningful event; stationary can be menu, idle or vista. No scenic meaning inferred.
signals.minimum_runtime_test: Sample low rate and inspect mount/teleport discontinuities.
signals.cadence_and_duplicate_semantics: Continuous property; cadence chosen by future adapter, not per-frame required.

signals.availability: verified source implementation; mod delivery not runtime-tested
signals.semantics: Player IsInInterior query and native interior-area callbacks.
signals.integration: Public imported player query; local component callbacks.
signals.reliability_limits: isCave field says postprocessing use, not universal cave classifier; trigger overlap/blends exist.
signals.minimum_runtime_test: Log interior query vs natural doorway; do not assume all caves.
signals.cadence_and_duplicate_semantics: Overlap/entry state; multiple volumes can blend or overlap.

signals.availability: verified source implementation; mod delivery not runtime-tested
signals.semantics: ShouldEnableCombatMusic combines forced combat, threats, enemies and finishing; sound calls combat callbacks.
signals.reliability_limits: IsInCombat alone incomplete; callback end occurs before full musical outro.
signals.minimum_runtime_test: Log classifier and native State; do not modify combat callback or threat RTPC.
signals.cadence_and_duplicate_semantics: Classifier/state changes; finish callback precedes actual audio outro.

signals.availability: not exposed in inspected script sound API; Wwise source/playback verified report90
signals.semantics: Exploration returns before native transition segment ends.
signals.integration: Keep guard in Wwise; no verified script callback/cursor.
signals.reliability_limits: Never equate OnCombatFinished, exploration or fixed30s with observed completion.
signals.minimum_runtime_test: Future gateway must enforce actual transition ownership/quiet internally; external controller stays uncertain otherwise.
signals.cadence_and_duplicate_semantics: Actual audio transition boundary; no script notification established.

signals.availability: verified Wwise routing; no complete script ownership getter established
signals.semantics: Explicit authored event selects music_type=quests_cutscenes and authored subselector independently of game_state.
signals.integration: Native Wwise music_type gate; complete native-event interception from script unproven.
signals.reliability_limits: World branch includes protected/mixed selections. Direct Play of imported cue could bypass selector priority.
signals.minimum_runtime_test: Prove a request gateway inside reviewed generic selector; unknown ownership must deny, not infer from scene absence.
signals.cadence_and_duplicate_semantics: Music event/switch transitions independent of scene-state changes.

signals.availability: verified source implementation; mod delivery not runtime-tested
signals.semantics: Blocking/cutscene/movie-start paths set native sound States; script scene checks also used by weather commentary.
signals.integration: Existing sound State and scene queries.
signals.reliability_limits: Scene absence != absence of authored music during gameplay. Movie state method has source typo OnEnterSate; use actual OnMovieStarted path.
signals.minimum_runtime_test: Log scene predicates and public sound state during ordinary unforced play.
signals.cadence_and_duplicate_semantics: Scene lifecycle edges; gameplay/ordinary dialogue/film are not one ownership signal.

signals.availability: verified source implementation; mod delivery not runtime-tested
signals.semantics: Active/paused/stopped predicates and load completion event; area init stops old music.
signals.integration: Public engine queries plus localized lifecycle callback.
signals.reliability_limits: Loading completion must acquire fresh context/ownership, never replay queued discovery; real-time vs game-time distinction.
signals.minimum_runtime_test: Log initialization and user reload without altering saves.
signals.cadence_and_duplicate_semantics: Native state queries and load callback; invalidate old epoch and pending opportunities.

signals.availability: verified source implementation; mod delivery not runtime-tested
signals.integration: Dispatcher is accessible; semantic interpretation per fact is unsupported.
signals.reliability_limits: No generic quest-completed/story-music-free meaning; narrative spoiler/conflict risk.
signals.minimum_runtime_test: No pilot trigger; only separately reviewed facts could qualify.
signals.cadence_and_duplicate_semantics: Potentially frequent gameplay mutations, not a scoring event bus.

signals.availability: absent as a semantic query in inspected engine APIs/common map interface
signals.semantics: Position/elevation exist; scenic significance and biome fit do not follow.

signals.minimum_runtime_test: Requires curated authored context evidence; do not invent vista events.
